turns.user_message: @web How do I debug a pod in CrashLoopBackOff?

steps.text:
To help you debug a pod in CrashLoopBackOff, I will first check your K8SCluster and K8SPod models to locate the affected pod(s) and then look up the logs and events.  
Could you please specify the cluster name (or namespace) and the pod name you want to investigate?
